result.labelEn: In semester 1, students take a set of 3-credit courses (Biostratigraphy, Introductory Micropalaeontology, Geobiology, Carbonate Facies Analysis, Quantitative Palaeontology, Phylogenetics, Geobiosphere Interactions in Deep Time, Statistics Initiation with R, Project Management, and a collaborative project) at Université de Lille in France within the main field of Earth Science.
Courses in semester 2 are taken at Uppsala University.

note.textSv: Examensarbeteskursen kan alternativt läsas vid: Université de Lille, Frankrike (Learning and Evaluation Situation, Bibliographic project & internship, 30 ECTS)Eller vid de andra partneruniversiteten: University of Minho (Dissertation/Project, 30 ECTS) National and Kapodistrian University of Athens (Postgraduate dissertation in climatic variations and impact on the environment, 30 ECTS) Huvudområde(n) med fördjupning: Geovetenskap A2E för samtliga examensarbeten.

result.labelEn: The degree project may alternatively be completed at a partner university (Lille, Minho, or Athens) for 30 ECTS, with main field Earth Science A2E.
